_comment: Curated third-party NAMING CLAIMS: naming assertions a lab or vendor publishes that bestiary cannot derive mechanically from the catalog (aliases, HuggingFace repo mappings, purls). This is the claim INPUTS layer of the naming stack: the parse/data decomposition files are decomposition CONFIG, this file is claim INPUTS, and the minted Nomina are the queryable OUTPUT records. Each claim carries source_url (WHO asserts the naming — a claimant URL) DISTINCT from source_id (WHICH ingest we read it from — a DataSourceID FK). scheme defaults to 'alias'; status defaults to 'admitted' (a third-party claim is admitted, never preferred — only the canonical key is preferred); source_id defaults to 'curated' (bestiary read the claim from THIS committed curation file, not from models.dev or Ollama — the honest ingest provenance, distinct from the claimant source_url). Graceful-degrade at runtime, LOUD at codegen (see nomen_claims.go).
